stances.summary: Distinguishes productive taxation from rent extraction
stances.quote: Don't be silly. You are confusing tax paid on productive activity with tax paid on rents. The former adds to wealth and total tax revenues. The latter does not add to wealth and simply transfers tax payments from sector of the economy to another.

stances.quote:
2/4
